target.summary: In convertNumBase, values without a '0x', '#', or '$' prefix default to base 10 instead of base 16, which causes unprefixed hexadecimal patch values to be parsed as decimal or throw std::invalid_argument on non-decimal characters. Furthermore, isHexSym recognizes '$' and '#' as prefixes, but std::stoul and std::stoull do not support these prefixes and will fail to parse them.
